summary: Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd, a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a 6-K furnishing a notice of extraordinary general meeting to be held on July 8, 2026. The meeting seeks shareholder approval for a share redesignation of 40M Class A and 20M Class C ordinary shares into blank shares, an increase of authorized share capital from $50,000 to $1.2 million (120 billion shares total), and a 240:1 share consolidation of all issued and unissued ordinary shares, effective after the mandatory exchange of all outstanding ADSs. The consolidation reduces the share count and increases par value from $0.00001 to $0.0024 per share. No board recommendation, advisor, or specific price per share is disclosed. Watch for post-consolidation liquidity and the mechanics of the ADS exchange.
